title: Ipswich Town Signs Serbian Midfielder Sasa Lukic From Fulham
dek: Ipswich Town completed the signing of Serbian midfielder Sasa Lukic from Fulham on an undisclosed fee, with Lukic signing a contract through 2030. The 29-year-old made 26 Premier League appearances last season and 106 total appearances for Fulham. This marks the second player Ipswich has acquired from Fulham in the 2026 summer window.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Sasa Lukic, a 29-year-old Serbian midfielder with 26 Premier League appearances last season, has joined Ipswich Town from Fulham on a four-year deal.
bottom_line: Lukic joins Ipswich with Premier League experience and a four-year commitment, part of a sustained summer recruitment drive. Watch whether he integrates quickly into Ipswich's midfield setup and whether the Fulham connection yields further moves before the window closes.
body: Ipswich Town have completed the signing of Serbian midfielder Sasa Lukic from Fulham, adding experience to their midfield ahead of the Premier League season. According to BBC Sport, Lukic, 29, has signed a contract with Ipswich through 2030 on an undisclosed transfer fee.

Lukic made 26 Premier League appearances for Fulham last season and appeared in 106 matches overall for the club before the move. His arrival strengthens Ipswich's roster depth at a position central to their tactical approach during a competitive transfer window.

The signing represents the second player Ipswich has recruited from Fulham in the 2026 summer window, following the earlier acquisition of Morocco defender Issa Diop. Per BBC Sport's report, Lukic stated upon joining: "I can't wait to play here as a home player."
The transfer fee remains undisclosed, a common practice in modern football moves. Ipswich's summer business now includes multiple incoming acquisitions as the club prepares for the upcoming campaign.
